primary_meaning: A place of divine revelation, theophany, or encounter with the presence of God (often linked to covenant, law, temple, or the kingdom of God).
primary_basis: Exodus 19–20 (Sinai/Horeb as site of theophany and law-giving)
Psalm 48:1–2 and Psalm 2:6 (Zion as God's holy mountain and dwelling)
Isaiah 2:2–3 / Micah 4:1–2 (mountain of the house of the Lord)

alternatives.meaning: Obstacles, difficulties, or challenges that faith can overcome or remove
Kingdoms, empires, nations, or political/world powers
Sites of idolatry or illegitimate worship (high places)

notes: Biblical usage is strongly context-dependent; the divine-encounter/theophany sense is the most frequent positive symbolic assignment in Christian teaching and biblical theology, yet prophetic, wisdom, and Synoptic texts regularly support other readings without contradiction. No single fixed meaning dominates every genre.
